generic_sampling_rules.text_categorical: sample from a small pool of 3-12 distinct strings; for a column with a LIKE/equality target create exact literal plus near-variants (case change, trailing 'x', trailing ' x', prefix/suffix '%' forms) with near-variant share 15-30%
generic_sampling_rules.text_name_like: sample from a name pool; on DISTINCT-target columns repeat values so duplicate share is 20-50%
generic_sampling_rules.integer_id: sequential distinct integers starting at 1; never NULL; on join columns reserve specific parent ids as childless (~20-30% of parents) and only rarely ~5-10% NULL child foreign keys when the child column is nullable
generic_sampling_rules.integer_quantity_positive: uniform integer in [1, max_observed]; never 0; one NULL row per instance on nullable integer columns
generic_sampling_rules.real_amount: uniform real in [0.1, 1.5 * max_observed], rounded to 1 decimal; non-negative; include boundary values at listed literals: literal-0.1, literal, literal+0.1, literal+1 when a comparison target is given
generic_sampling_rules.date: ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'; for date pairs keep first <= second
generic_sampling_rules.enum_short: pick from explicit value list given in per_column_exceptions
generic_sampling_rules.tie_and_order_columns: on an ORDER target column place at least two rows tied at each listed rank with the listed direction (e.g. 2 rows at maximum value for DESC rank 1); never overwrite a planted boundary literal or near-variant to create the tie
generic_sampling_rules.group_size_pattern: for GROUP-target columns arrange group cardinalities: at least one value appearing once, one appearing twice, and one appearing >=3 times; verify after all other mutations
generic_sampling_rules.null_rule: each instance has at least one NULL row for every nullable column; NULL share approx observed null rate (0% observed -> still plant >=1 NULL); NULL never replaced to satisfy a rule; rules constrain non-NULL values only; NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL
generic_sampling_rules.fresh_value_share: when a pool is exhausted use fresh values with share 10-20%
generic_sampling_rules.pk_uniqueness: primary keys (single or composite) are generated sequentially/without collision against compact rows and within the block; composite keys are deduped as tuples

targets.integer_valued_real_ids: 1.0,2.0,... sequential distinct, no collision with compact rows

targets.joint_verification: all four targets hold simultaneously after all mutations
